name: c-sheet-1
title: Sheet containing a form for editing profile information
label: Profile Editor
description: Sheet containing a form for editing profile information.

guidance.bestFor: A right side profile editor with 2 fields, Save changes, Cancel and the corner X
agentNotes: The inputs use `defaultValue` and no form element wraps them, so Save changes submits nothing yet

name: c-sheet-2
title: Sheet without a corner close button
label: No Close Button
description: Sheet containing a profile form with the corner close button hidden, so the footer Cancel button closes it.

guidance.bestFor: The profile editor without the corner X, leaving footer Cancel as the visible way out
agentNotes: Save changes is a submit `Button` outside any form, so add the form element and your handler

name: c-sheet-3
title: Sheets that open from any side
label: Any Side
description: Sheets that open from any side.

guidance.bestFor: One trigger per edge, top, right, bottom and left, with top and bottom sheets held to half the screen
agentNotes: Keep 1 value of `sides` and pass it as `side`; the demo mounts a sheet for every edge

guidance.bestFor: A long body in a ScrollArea between a pinned header and a Save and Cancel footer
agentNotes: `ScrollArea` fills the height between header and footer through `flex-1` and `min-h-0`, so it needs no fixed height when either changes
